test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Nov, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

No sunflower is a lily.

No lily is a rose.

Conclusions:

(i) No sunflower is a rose.

(ii) No rose is a lily.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusion I and II follow

solution:
**Statements:**

No sunflower is a lily.

No lily is a rose.

The least possible venn diagram is given below.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5b9b84e179939a3c8e8b92a8707f552f0a87e38eb40d10c3c5c5daf743765067.png] 

**Conclusions:**

(i) No sunflower is a rose - **False**(because, there is no direct relation is given so, it can be possible only).

(ii) No rose is a lily - **True**(because, no liliy is rose, it implies that no rose is lily).

Thus, Only conclusion II follows

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 4".**
